profile.headline: Distributed Software & Kubernetes Engineer
profile.summary:
With 18 years of experience in building distributed systems, I've had the privilege to dive deep into the world of open-source for over 23 years. My journey has been exciting and rewarding, especially over the last 6 years contributing to the Kubernetes project, during which I've gained valuable production-scale experience.

I spent 8 years as a full-time contributor to OpenStack, collaborating with various companies and the OpenStack Foundation. My time at DreamHost was particularly memorable, during which I played a key role in assembling the development team and creating DreamCompute, our public cloud offering based on OpenStack. This experience led me to explore powerful technologies like the Ceph distributed filesystem, specifically working with its Rados Block Device layer and its integration with OpenStack.

As a Community Architect for Red Hat's Open Source Program Office (OSPO), I’ve enjoyed supporting vibrant communities like Ceph, Rook, and Argo. Assisting these communities fills me with excitement and reinforces my passion for open-source.

I've also explored and learned from a variety of other open-source projects along the way, including libvirt, the vhost-SCSI device driver in the Linux kernel, CPAN, and the Amarok music player. Each step has enriched my understanding and fueled my enthusiasm for innovation in this space.

I’m always eager to connect with fellow enthusiasts and contribute to impactful projects, so let’s collaborate and make great things happen together!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintenance with Ceph CSI Kubernetes driver for block and file level storage.
• Updating Ansible playbooks used in Ceph upstream infrastructure.
• Moved Ceph's upstream binary storage project Chacra from the previous API framework to FastAPI.
• Support Ceph upstream infrastructure (CI pipeline, GitHub Actions).
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Python (Programming Language) · Ansible · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ceph RBD, integration in OpenStack Cinder and Kubernetes-CSI.

positions.title: Board Member
positions.description:
• Participated in the initial start of the Foundation in November 2018
• Membership relations/renewals
• Budget planning

positions.title: Senior Community Architect
positions.description:
• Founded the Ceph Foundation, establishing a multi-million-dollar, unbiased governing entity holding the core trademarks with 36 initial global enterprise and Academic sponsors.

• Formulated and implemented formal open-source community governance models, driving multi-organizational consensus and cross-company engineering collaboration frameworks.

• Directed global technical evangelism, executing 17 major "Ceph Day" events internationally within the first fiscal year to expand ecosystem adoption and drive corporate contributions.

• Served as a strategic advisor on software licensing, compliance, and multi-project architectural alignment across auxiliary open-source storage initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Budget Management · Open-Source Software · Community Leadership · Code of Conduct · Data Storage · Written Communication · Open Source Licensing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Revived and refactored the vHost-SCSI Linux Kernel driver, directly implementing upstream integration support inside LibVirt to bridge low-latency block virtualization constraints.

• Designed and engineered native native vHost-SCSI virtualization hooks across core OpenStack ecosystem projects including Nova (Compute), Cinder (Block Storage), and Glance (Image Registry).

• Authored and integrated Datera's proprietary enterprise block storage driver directly into the OpenStack Cinder framework.

positions.title: Developer Coordinator
positions.description:
• Coordinated architectural alignment and engineering contributions for a global network of 40,000+ distributed developers across remote channels and large-scale foundation technical assemblies.

• Designed and enforced a mandatory Continuous Integration (CI) hardware testing policy for all physical storage vendors. Successfully scaled the enterprise storage driver ecosystem from 50 to 120+ validated production drivers, drastically reducing downstream storage regression failures. 

• Architected and deployed a centralized Community Health Dashboard monitoring telemetry across 45+ distinct sub-projects, providing critical systemic data utilized by foundation leadership for executive keynote projections.

• Engaged directly with Fortune 100 enterprise infrastructure architects to capture scale constraints, optimizing designs for computing environments exceeding 100K+ processor cores.

positions.title: OpenStack Contributor
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Ansible

positions.title: Cinder Project Technical Lead
positions.description: Elected by OpenStack contributors to maintain the block storage project Cinder upstream in the Kilo and Liberty release.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Expanded top-level domain registration offering from .com, .net, .org, .info to 100+ TLD's.
• Rewrote legacy billing system from a monolithic design, broken out to be more manageable for package offerings and promo codes, and introduced unit tests.
• Worked on integration with Ceph in OpenStack with Cinder RBD driver.
• Assisted with the block storage deployment of a 100+ node Ceph cluster in DreamCompute public cloud.
• Maintained Cinder and Nova services in DreamCompute public cloud.
• Worked on initial private DreamHost authentication integration into OpenStack Identity service Keystone.

positions.title: Interim VP of Development
positions.description:
• Managed the entire DreamHost development team and all related projects in their lifecycle in an agile environment.
• Led the DreamHost OneClick app catalog product
• Led the revamp of the DreamHost API
• Defined yearly roadmaps and release plans with other teams.
• Wrote software specification documents and estimates for projects
• Assisted senior software engineers in architecting projects as well as helping other developers with solutions.
• Handled all business development relations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Refactored the in-house customer dashboard and separated the implementation into reusable components.
• Introduced the DreamHost REST API for users to develop Android/iPhone apps and web applications.
• Assisted with developing DreamHost’s first VPS solution using Linux VServer.
• Optimized in-house tech support system handling 1000+ tickets daily.
• Developed an application for cPanel users to migrate their accounts over to DreamHost Dashboard.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Handled all design solutions for given projects within a reasonable time to meet deadlines set by project managers. Designed an automated Linux packaging system for admins. Designed a completely new custom control panel for handling hosting needs. Provided help to others, such as admins, with infrastructure designs, Postfix, Apache, and security advice.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Rewrote the entire custom e-commerce solution in PHP to handle both new requirements and run more efficiently than the previous design. Refactored most of the backend with an object-oriented programming concept in mind.
